cases.name: blog_canonical_route
cases.expected: source_module=blog and entity_type=blog_post derive /modules/blog?slug=... from a bounded safe projected slug

cases.name: blog_fail_closed
cases.expected: wrong source module missing slug non-string slug traversal spaces and overlong slugs remain non-navigable

cases.name: forum_projection_owner_routes
cases.expected: Forum Search projection resolves exact category and topic descriptors through ForumCategoryRouteService and ForumTopicRouteService before writing payload.route

cases.name: forum_category_topic_routes
cases.expected: canonical forum_category and forum_topic results expose only exact localized owner-projected routes after Search validates locale identity entity identity short topic identity and path shape

cases.name: forum_reply_canonical_route
cases.expected: canonical forum_reply exposes the owner-projected localized topic route with one exact reply query only when reply and topic identities match

cases.name: forum_reply_fail_closed
cases.expected: wrong source module missing or malformed payload mismatched identities locale drift short-id drift unsafe paths and incorrect reply queries remain non-navigable

cases.name: forum_stale_projection_fail_closed
cases.expected: legacy UUID query routes and documents missing the owner-projected route remain non-navigable until the Forum projection is rebuilt; no compatibility fallback exists

cases.name: product_and_content_routes
cases.expected: product and content routes are derived by the same Search-owned policy

cases.name: content_kind_injection
cases.expected: unsafe source-module values cannot inject additional query parameters

cases.name: graphql_owner_projection
cases.expected: GraphQL result mapping delegates to canonical_search_result_url

cases.name: storefront_native_owner_projection
cases.expected: native storefront result mapping delegates to canonical_search_result_url before crossing the server-function boundary

cases.name: admin_native_owner_projection
cases.expected: Search admin mapping delegates to canonical_search_result_url from its focused mapping part

cases.name: admin_shell_owner_projection
cases.expected: admin global search delegates to canonical_search_result_url and accepts canonical Blog and Forum result types

cases.name: admin_forum_permission_gate
cases.expected: admin global search requires Forum category topic or reply read permission for canonical Forum results and rejects spoofed source pairs

cases.name: no_transport_fallback
cases.expected: storefront transport selection returns backend-projected URLs directly and no navigation compatibility module or UUID Forum fallback exists

runtime_promotion_requirements: execute rustok-search engine URL policy tests
rebuild Forum Search projections so every visible category topic and approved reply contains the canonical localized owner route
execute GraphQL storefrontSearch against reindexed Forum category topic and reply documents
execute native storefront search and confirm canonical localized URLs are present
execute Search admin preview and admin global search against product content Blog and Forum results
verify admin global search enforces Forum category topic and reply domain permissions
verify click analytics records the canonical localized href
verify malformed and stale Forum payloads remain non-navigable through every transport
verify no UUID Forum query route is emitted after reindex
